This work has no issue. Build this story, and do not ask me anything: where you would ask, decide, and say what you decided in your hand-off.

## Problem Statement

Users who unsubscribed from email still get cart reminders from `remindersFor` (`src/reminders.mjs`).

## Solution

A user whose `prefs.unsubscribed` is `true` gets no reminder.

## User Stories

1. As a User who unsubscribed (`prefs.unsubscribed: true`), I get no cart reminder, so that unsubscribing means what it says

## Testing Decisions

Unit tests with `node:test`, beside the existing ones in `test/reminders.test.mjs`.
